info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Quantitative Model Data Retrieval API
info.description: The Quantitative Model Data Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve comprehensive market data related to quantitative models used in banking. This API serves financial analysts and developers focused on integrating sophisticated analytics into their applications. Users can obtain critical insights that drive investment strategies, risk assessments, and decision-making processes. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their financial modeling capabilities and obtain timely market analysis.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the latest quantitative model data available in the market. Utilize this endpoint to fetch detailed insights and parameters of various quant models used for market analysis.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve market data using the quantitative model. The request body must adhere to the provided schema and include the necessary parameters for the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully and data retrieved.

GetQuantModelMarketDataRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the market data quant model.

GetQuantModelMarketDataResponse_200.title: Market Data Quant Model Response

items.description: A list of market data items.

sort.description: The sort order applied to the items.

GetQuantModelMarketDataResponse_200.description: Response schema for the market data quant model GET operation, containing a list of items, pagination details, sort order, and metadata.
